comment: One row for each rule of the process-exit producer (src/fort/ownership_source_exit.ft),
the termination classes of the FFI hook (src/fort/ownership_ffi.ft), the runtime cleanup
(std/rt.ft), the report (src/fort/ownership_report.ft) and the witness walk mode
(src/fort/ownership_source_local.ft). A row names the line that holds the rule and the
text that breaks it. The build compiles working-tree HEAD with the mutant, and the module
tests compile src/fort and std with the mutant too. The stages run the process-exit, FFI
termination, runtime shutdown and report tests, then the ownership driver test. Run it in
the Linux VM with the debug preset. The stage logs, not the `tests` field, name the
catching test: these stages run test/lang/run_tests.py.

stages.name: process-exit module tests
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --timeout 900 -j 6 ownership_source_exit ownership_ffi_termination ownership_report_exit ownership_source_local_witness_mode
